title: Address
description: Portable international address with medium-grained fields. This schema maps to Google's open source AddressValidationMetadata (https://github.com/googlei18n/libaddressinput/wiki/AddressValidationMetadata) and to HTML 5.1 autocomplete fields (https://www.w3.org/TR/html51/semantics.html#attr-fe-autocomplete-street-address).

address_line_1.description: Line 1 of the address (eg. number, street, etc). Example: '173 Drury Lane'.

address_line_2.description: Optional line 2 of the address (eg. suite, apt #, etc.).

address_line_3.description: Optional Line 3 of the address. May be used for street complement for Brazil, or direction text for India (eg. 'next to Walmart').

admin_area_4.description: May be neighborhood, ward or district. Smaller than admin_area_level_3 and sub_locality. Use this for the postal sorting code in Guernsey and many French territories such as French Guiana, and fine-grained administrative levels in China.

admin_area_3.description: Usually sub-locality, suburb, neighborhood, or district. Smaller than admin_area_level_2. Use this for a bairro/neighborhood in Brazil. In India, street name information is often not available, but a sublocality/district can be a very small area.

admin_area_2.description: Usually city, town or village. Smaller than admin_area_level_1.

admin_area_1.description: This is the highest-level subdivision of a country, and usually corresponds to a province, state, or ISO-3166-2 subdivision. This will be a state in the USA, a province in Canada, a prefecture in Japan, a kanton in Switzerland, and a county in UK. This would be expected to be the form that would appear in addresses formatted for postal delivery, eg. 'CA' not 'California'.

address_details.description: Additional address details sometimes needed for compliance, risk, and other scenarios where fine-grain or high-resolution address information may be needed.

street_name.description: Street name.  Just 'Drury' in 'Drury Lane'. If the street type is not available from a address service, then this should contain both the street name and type – 'Drury Lane'.

delivery_service.description: Delivery service. May be a post office box, post office name, bag number, etc.

building_name.description: The building name or number, or other named location that identifies the premises. Example: 'Craven House'.

sub_building.description: Sub-premise. First-order entity below a named building or location, usually a singular building within a collection of buildings with a common name, or could be flat, storey, floor, unit number, room and/or apartment.
